messages:
sara: FYI customer (acct: acme-corp) says console analytics show 0 requests when they filter region=eu-west-1 + model=redwood-alpha + version=v2. API logs show normal traffic. Ticket #12345. Screenshot: https://rbw-internal/attachments/12345/console-0.png :eyes:

mike: Can you paste quick repro steps? I want to try the same filters locally.

sara: Steps: Analytics -> Requests -> Region: EU West (eu-west-1) -> Model: redwood-alpha -> Version: v2 -> Last 24h. Chart goes flat to 0.
Also ran a quick API query from their tenant: `GET /v1/metrics?tenant=acme&start=2026-03-13T00:00Z&end=2026-03-14T00:00Z&group_by=region,model,version` returns non-zero totals for eu-west-1/redwood-alpha/v2.

leah: sounds like a filtering/aggregation mismatch. We normalize tags in the pipeline; sometimes version tag shows up as empty string vs `v2`. UI filter expects exact match so rows with empty/NULL `version` get dropped when both region+model filters applied.

kevin: Repro query in ClickHouse I used to confirm: ```
SELECT region, model, version, count() as cnt
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE tenant_id = 'acme' AND ts >= '2026-03-13' AND ts < '2026-03-14'
GROUP BY region, model, version
ORDER BY cnt DESC
```
Results show a chunk of rows where `version` is `''` (empty) but same model+region have non-empty version buckets too. UI filter pipeline was doing `version IS NOT NULL` during rollup which removed the matches when version was empty in one path.

support-bot: [ingestion-pipeline] tag-normalizer service: last deploy 2026-03-12T04:22Z. No active alerts. Backfill queue length: 0.

mike: I can reproduce locally. The problem is in the reducer step `applyFilterTags` where we build the filter predicate. For combined filters we were translating to `(region = X) AND (model = Y) AND (version = Z)` but version was missing in the rollup index for some shards so a separate OR branch drops those rows because of `version != ''` guard we added earlier. Patch incoming.

kevin: Opening quickfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5482 — it changes normalization to map empty/NULL versions to the literal `unknown-version` before indexing, and updates the UI filter component to accept that token. Also will kick off a backfill job to re-materialize aggregates for last 72h for affected tenants.

sara: What's the timeline? Customer is asking for ETA, they hit this during an important run.

mike: Plan: merge to canary in ~2h, monitor for 30m, then promote to prod if canary OK. Backfill will run after prod deploy; estimate 3-4 hours for 72h window. Will notify support. Rollback: revert PR and purge new tokens (same process as other backfills).

leah: Adding unit/integration tests to catch both `''` and `NULL` version values. Also suggest UI show `unknown-version` as a humanized label "(unknown)" to avoid confusing customers.

kevin: Started backfill job schedule: job-id bf-2026-03-14-001, target tenants: acme-corp + others with similar patterns.

sara: Thanks team. I'll update the customer with the canary + backfill ETA and keep ticket #12345 open until they confirm. :thumbsup:

mike: I'll post updates in #eng-runtime once canary is green.

leah: filing follow-up doc for root-cause and long-term fix (ticket 12346).

sara: closing loop here for now.
